question: Does the exact-shape 40.27% grouped-MLA component lead from eight KV splits materially reduce matched end-to-end GLM-4.7-Flash serving cost and latency on L40S?
answer: No at the preregistered 5% materiality gate. Two same-session bracketed effects were +1.0476% and +1.0447% c8 throughput, median +1.0461%, while SLO and paired diagnostics passed. The component optimization executed and removed measured MLA work, but did not materially shorten the serving execution span.

component.limitation: Single-run aggregate exact-shape component evidence; raw randomized/interleaved timing samples and a stability interval were not retained.

server_sequence.statistics: Two independent candidate repetitions are descriptive only; no bootstrap interval or significance language is admitted.

trace_transition.limitation: Annotation spans and summed kernel work are diagnostic, not a dependency-union wall-time attribution or Amdahl coefficient.

quality.stock_stability_warning: V24R1 scored 0.1667 and identical V24R2 scored 0.3333 because one exact long-context output included an extra prefix.
quality.claim_effect: No general quality-adjusted, provider-matched, or business cost claim is allowed.

economics.rate_basis: Nebius preemptible L40S full VM 0.8484 USD/hour plus disk 0.0097222 USD/hour; public IPv4/egress excluded; invoice pending.
economics.accounting_rule: Full session exposure supersedes overlapping provisional arm estimates.

falsification_result: The data reject the assumption that a large exact-shape MLA component reduction transfers materially to this tuned c8 server workload. The split count is not the current end-to-end bottleneck.
residual_bottleneck: Dense GEMM/GEMV is the largest residual measured decode kernel family, but memory, occupancy, launch, dependency, and host-scheduling causes remain unseparated because Nsight Compute/GPM counters were unavailable.
next_actions_ranked: Calibrate a prospective expanded executable quality suite and disjoint holdout off GPU; do not alter the frozen current result.

Add a matched profiler-off/on phase trace with vLLM execution annotations, host CPU/scheduler timing, Nsight Systems, standard DCGM utilization/memory-controller/power/energy fields, attribution coverage, and dependency-union intervals.
Use the resulting resource signature to choose a dense GEMM/GEMV or MoE intervention; first falsify it with exact-shape replay/microbenchmark and raw interleaved samples.
Add representative arrival-rate, prefix/session, and overload frontiers before any Fireworks/Baseten competitiveness claim.
